executive_summary: EchoAtlas is a mid-market contact-center vendor building a multilingual agent-assist layer for enterprise customers (retail + travel). They want low-latency snippet suggestions, automated ticket summarization, and reliable tool-calling to Zendesk/Salesforce. Strategic ask: deliver consistent behavior across NA/EU/APAC with clear residency + audit controls. Evaluation focused on Dedicated capacity for predictable spikes and Optimize for cost tuning.
technical_requirements:
- Workloads: live agent assist (fast hint generation), post-chat ticket summarization, on-the-fly translation + locale-aware tone adaptation, regional routing.
- Targets: p95 inference latency <= 350ms for 1-3 sentence suggestions; summarization batch jobs okay at 1-2s; max sustained throughput during promos: 2k reqs/min with spikes to 6k reqs/min for ~10-30 minutes.
- Model preferences: open Llama-family variants + option to fall back to smaller quantized models for cost. Must support streaming, function calling to trigger tool actions (create/update tickets), and KV/prefix caching for repeated context.
- Integrations: Zendesk / Salesforce / Genesys - secure tool-calls via signed Webhooks, OAuth flows for service accounts.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, trace links for suggestion->tool call.
- Security: SSO (SAML), KMS for keys, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Non-functional: graceful fallback to cached replies during transient capacity loss; ability to route traffic to alternate region seamlessly.

- Implementation notes: prefer using Redwood SDK for streaming to minimize custom polling. SE recommended prefix caching for FAQ-like repeated questions.

use_case_summary: Primary: live agent assist (context-aware completions + tool calling) and multilingual ticket summarization. Secondary: real-time translation and tone adaptation for cross-region support, with routing policies to ensure data residency and low latency. POC will validate reliability under marketing-driven traffic spikes and the idempotency of tool-calling routines.
deployment_notes: Prefer VPC + private endpoints for Dedicated; will consider hosted API for non-sensitive tenants. Air-gap not required. They want ability to pin model versions per region and automatic fallback chains. Documented requirement to have per-tenant audit logs exported to customer SIEM.
poC_success_criteria: 1) p95 suggestion latency <=350ms for 95% of POC window; 2) no duplicate tickets created during 3 simulated tool-call failure scenarios; 3) EU-customer traffic stored in EU region only; 4) Optimize report with actionable batching/quantization plan and projected cost savings >= 35%
risk_assessment: Medium - tech fit strong but legal/data-residency and SLA for peaks are gating. Integration complexity moderate due to multiple contact-center vendors (Zendesk + Genesys).
